mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_orchestrator_agent WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND orchestrator_id = #{orchestratorId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS id, a.user_id AS userId, a.agent_name AS agentName, a.system_prompt AS systemPrompt, a.next_step_prompt AS nextStepPrompt, a.provider AS provider, a.model_name AS modelName, a.enabled AS enabled, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_time AS updateTime FROM user_orchestrator_agent b JOIN user_agent a ON a.id = b.agent_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.orchestrator_id = #{orchestratorId} AND a.enabled = 1 ORDER BY b.id ASC
